title: Invalid Claude Code API Key Configuration on MacOS Claude Code-credentials vs Claude Code
body:
**Bug Description**
When configuring Claude Desktop on MacOS to use Claude Code, I receive the following login error:\

```
{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Invalid API key · Please run /login"}],"totalDurationMs":36,"totalTokens":0,"totalToolUseCount":0,"usage":{"input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":0,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0}},"wasInterrupted":false}\]
```

claude_desktop_config.json contains:
```
"claude-code": {
      "command": "claude",
      "args": ["mcp", "serve"],
      "env": {
        "HOME": "/Users/ryan"
      }
    }
```

I have verified that I have a valid token:[REDACTED]

```
security find-generic-password -a $USER -w -s "Claude Code-credentials"
{"claudeAiOauth":{"accessToken":"sk-ant
```

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: windsurf
- Version: 1.0.3
- Feedback ID: a6637031-48b8-41a9-85d7-49e0a2cb94fc
